name: Article 4, § 2 – 68
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Public interface connected to the Internal Market Information System for the declaration of posting of workers and amending Regulation (EU) No 1024/2012
part_text: 2. The Commission shall establish the standard form referred to in paragraph 1 of this Article by way of implementing acts. Those implementing acts shall be adopted in accordance with the procedure referred to in Article 8(2). Such implementing acts shall not introduce information requirements beyond those strictly necessary for the identification of the service provider, the posted worker and the posting assignment, in accordance with Article 9(1), point (a), of Directive 2014/67/EU.
